evidence.title: FormuEvo: LLM-Guided Evolution for Discovering Solver-Efficient Mixed-Integer Programming Formulations

summary: A new method called FormuEvo uses large language models to evolve and discover more efficient formulations for solving mixed-integer programming problems. The approach aims to improve solver performance by automating the search for optimal problem representations.
title: AI Researchers Introduce FormuEvo: LLM-Guided Evolution for Optimizing Mixed-Integer Programming
